verdict.rationale: Asking whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for a SaaS video API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training, data-use policies, or an opt-out. The nearby items on end-to-end encryption, regional media zones and signed callbacks are adjacent controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
